notes.title: Maraka released!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that our new game, Maraka, has officially launched today!

This project has been a labor of love for the past three years, and while it may not be the turn-based tactics RPG some of you were hoping for, we’re incredibly proud to introduce this bold new experiment—a dynamic, physics-based action game.

Of course, our work isn’t over yet! We’re committed to refining the experience, fixing bugs, and making ongoing improvements to ensure Maraka reaches its full potential.

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to hear your thoughts!

David

notes.title: Build 0.88.08 live!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

another build was rolled out, adding:

- new environment biome (crystalline), new caves, 
- overhauled astro weapon visuals
- new music tracks by our music composer Tomas Oliva (he's done amazing work also for Urtuk)
- additions to geometry and physical behavior of some effects and abilities
- bugfixes

Please let us know if you enjoy the demo and what else we can improve and work on!

Thanks a lot!

David

notes.title: New build available: 0.88.06
notes.content:
Hey all,

we've released new build, adding new features and content along, 
primarily:
 - new maps,
 - new music,
 - new creatures and enemies
 - more visual effects, audio and overall polish

Let us know how you liked it!

David

notes.title: New build available: 0.88.01
notes.content:
Hello all,

we've worked quite hard on new updates, and here they are!

Changes as of 0.88.01:

- added 'classes' for selection: they will provide you with starting modules to make the entrance into the game simpler
- reworked mission system: now you have a bigger, more feature-rich map, with lots of "going-on" parts, secrets, loots and much more!
- added lots of new visuals, effects, audio and 4 music tracts(for now as 'drafts' until our composer makes them final)
- meta progress: as you play the game, you unlock new modules - you can now build your own custom character with a new game meta currency "Astro coins".
- many bug fixes, polishments and UI enhancements

As always, any feedback is very welcome! Please help us improve the game!

thanks
David

notes.title: Future Plans
notes.content:
Hello all,

I want to share how our small team is going forward with the development of Maraka. 
As with our previous game, Urtuk: The Desolation, we'll be doing the production of the game with our community - [u]thus we really take your feedback and suggestions seriously[/u].

As of now, we've created a good code base, and the core gameplay loop is already solid (at least I think so). 
What we have now planned is more additions into the game:
- more [b]variety [/b]of maps, enemies and mission objectives
- more [b]abilities and skills[/b]
- more physics based environmental objects and hazards
- polishing [b]controllers[/b] (we already have controllers working, but it's only 80% optimal)
- adding new sounds
- adding [b]new OST[/b] (we've already began working on this!)
- (maybe) adding editing/mod tools for players

We want to have an up-to-date build of [u]Maraka always available for you[/u] (as playtest build, demo, or beta), so we can see how players react to new features - and we'll adjust based on that. Please, use Discord or Steam forum for communicating with us.

For the Steam Next festival, we aim to participate in the June's festival, and we want to have the Demo in really good shape.

As said, we really hope to make Maraka something special, and we aim for the 'fun factor' the most. So any suggestions are more than welcome! It might take months to nail all details, but in the end, we want to have a great game :)

Also, today I've pushed a new version of Maraka - [b]0.86.14[/b]. 
This adds new maps, objectives, abilities and the unlock/progress has been refined. 

Thanks for all your support!

David

notes.title: PLAYTEST ends
notes.content:
Thank you all for participating in our playtest build!
We've collected quite a bit of data and feedback going forward and improve our game.
In future, we'll post another playtest for you, maybe even in a month (our dev cycles are fast).

David

notes.title: PLAYTEST available!
notes.content:
Hello all,

as we progressed quite a bit with the development of Maraka, we would like to run a small playtest with you.
We would love to hear from you what you think about the game - mainly in terms of the "fun factor". We're quite early in development, and we still have time, based on your feedback, to adjust and improve the overall game experience.

You can [b]join the PLAYTEST[/b] at the Maraka store page with that green "Request Access" button, and in short time, I'll grant you access to the build via Steam email notification.

The best communication channel is our Discord or the Steam Forum:

Discord:
https://discord.gg/3fmaRzgnCk

Steam forum:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2586720/discussions

please let us know:
- are the basic combat/physics mechanics easy to use?
- is the combat fun? Or too complicated?
- is the tutorial good enough? Are there any details we miss?
- your own thoughts..

thanks!
David
